card.name: Commas in inactive ingredient lists
card.fires_on: Commas (and the next word start) inside lists of inactive ingredients such as cellulose, citric acid and dyes. Also the word "not" in "Do not crush, chew" swallow-whole instructions.

modes.label: Ingredient list commas
modes.description: Comma after an excipient name in an inactive ingredients list, or the start of a dye name like D&C.
modes.example: microcrystalline cellulose, anhydrous citric acid, croscarmellose sodium<<,>> D&C Red No. 7,

modes.label: The warning against crushing or chewing
modes.description: The word not after "Do" in instructions to swallow capsules whole.
modes.example: Swallow capsules whole. Do<< not>> crush, break, dissolve, or chew

card.plain: It responds to commas inside lists of tablet ingredients and to swallow-whole wording such as "Do not crush".
